components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; border: 1px solid transparent; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; transition: all 0.15s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.5 0.1 195); color: oklch(0.99 0.005 195); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.5 0.1 195 / 0.8); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.5 0.1 195); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.5 0.1 195 / 0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action button with a border, no fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.16 0.006 235); border: 1px solid oklch(0.914 0.004 235); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.967 0.003 235); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.5 0.1 195); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.5 0.1 195 / 0.5); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat container with a hairline ring border, used for auth forms and future content panels.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; padding: 1rem 0; border-radius: 0.875rem; background: oklch(1 0 0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.16 0.006 235 / 0.1); font-size: 0.875rem; color: oklch(0.16 0.006 235); } .ds-card-header { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0 1rem; } .ds-card-title { font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.375; } .ds-card-desc { font-size: 0.875rem; color: oklch(0.5 0.008 235); } .ds-card-content { padding: 0 1rem; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Text field used across all forms; shares the teal focus ring with buttons.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 2rem; width: 100%; min-width: 0; border-radius: 0.5rem; border: 1px solid oklch(0.914 0.004 235); background: transparent; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; font-size: 1rem; color: oklch(0.16 0.006 235); outline: none; transition: color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.5 0.008 235); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.5 0.1 195); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.5 0.1 195 / 0.5); } .ds-input:disabled { pointer-events: none; cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; background: oklch(0.967 0.003 235 / 0.5); } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325 / 0.2); }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item (active)
components.description: Active route in the authenticated shell's sidebar; teal-tinted fill.
components.css: .ds-navitem { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.625rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; color: oklch(0.96 0.004 235 / 0.8); transition: background-color 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-navitem-active { background: oklch(0.28 0.035 195); color: oklch(0.86 0.06 195); } .ds-navitem:not(.ds-navitem-active):hover { background: oklch(0.28 0.035 195 / 0.6); color: oklch(0.86 0.06 195); }

narrative.overview: Time Trackr replaces a spreadsheet, and the interface earns that trust by behaving like a well-kept one: calm, precise, legible at a glance, nothing decorative competing with the numbers. The system is near-monochrome ink-on-slate — Geist Variable throughout, flat surfaces separated by hairline borders rather than shadows — with exactly one accent color, a deep teal, spent only on the things that matter: the primary action, the active nav item, focus rings, and links. Teal was chosen over the indigo/violet that most AI-generated SaaS tools default to; it reads precise and slightly technical without competing with data density. Both light and dark tokens are first-class in the system, but there's no theme toggle yet, so the app ships dark-only by default.
keyCharacteristics: Near-neutral grayscale with a cool cast (hue ~235) everywhere except the one accent hue (~195, teal).
Flat by default: no box-shadows anywhere; depth comes from a ring-1 hairline border and background-tone contrast.
Teal is reserved for primary buttons, active/selected states, focus rings, and links only.
Geist Variable is the only typeface, carrying both UI text and headings.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal appears only on the primary action, the active/selected state, focus rings, and links. It never fills a card, a full section background, or a large decorative area.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every elevation cue is a ring-1/border hairline plus a one-step background-tone shift, never a box-shadow. This holds in both themes.

dos: Do reserve teal for exactly one thing per view: the primary action, the active nav state, a focus ring, or a link.
Do use the hairline-ring + tone-shift pattern for any new raised surface instead of adding a shadow.
Do keep both light and dark themes updated together.
Do use bg-destructive/10 for the default destructive button treatment.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent color without deliberately updating DESIGN.md.
Don't mix in a second typeface for headings or numerals.
Don't round corners past rounded-xl (cards) or below rounded-lg (buttons/inputs) without a documented reason.
